visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male rickshaw puller is shown from behind on a city street in Asakusa, Tokyo. He wears a traditional red happi coat with bold black characters on the back and black leggings. The Tokyo Skytree stands tall in the background under an overcast, bright sky. (2) The man turns his head to look at the camera with a friendly and warm smile. He has styled brown hair and an ID card badge clipped to his lapel. Traffic, including a white van and a black taxi, is visible on the road behind him. (3) He turns his full body towards the camera, laughing heartily and pointing his finger forward in a playful gesture. He stands between the handles of the rickshaw on a sidewalk marked with a bicycle lane. (4) The camera shifts to a POV shot of two young women seated inside the rickshaw. They are wearing elaborate white lace traditional-style dresses with puffed sleeves and have their hair styled with pearls and braids. They are smiling and laughing joyfully at the puller.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, upbeat pop music featuring a rhythmic electronic beat. A female voice calls out "Yuki-kun" with a friendly, questioning inflection. Ambient traffic noise is faintly heard in the background. (2) A male voice responds with a cheerful and polite "Hai." The female speaker then asks "Nani ga suki?" (What do you like?) in an animated, conversational tone while the music continues steadily. (3) The male speaker replies "Chokominto" (Chocolate mint) and immediately bursts into boisterous, energetic laughter. Multiple female voices join in with bright laughter, creating a high-arousal, joyful acoustic atmosphere. (4) The male character speaks in English, saying "So please call my name" with a clear, moderate delivery. The interactive dialogue loop repeats with the same questions and polite responses, maintaining a lively vocal rhythm. (5) The male speaker delivers a flirtatious punchline, "Chokominto yori mo... a-na-ta!" (More than chocolate mint... you!), which is immediately followed by high-pitched squealing and laughing from the female passengers.
